name: gizza-ai/color-palette-generator
summary: Generate a harmonious color palette from a base color.

tool.description: Generate a harmonious color palette from a base color using color theory. Accepts a base color (#hex, rgb(), or hsl()) and a scheme (complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic, square, monochromatic, shades, tints), and returns palette swatches in hex, rgb and hsl. Runs locally.

color.description: The base color in any common notation: #hex (3/6 digits), rgb(), or hsl().

count.description: How many colors for series schemes (analogous, monochromatic, shades, tints). Fixed schemes ignore this.
